subject: How to change font size in verbatimTextOutput?

messages.author: 54fc4f2407718083
messages.subject: How to change font size in verbatimTextOutput?
parts:
Hello

I am trying to understand how to use shiny in a markdown document (slide mode). After some calculations I would like to see the summary of the resulting data.frame but unfortunately the font size is too big in verbatimTextOutput("summary") . Is there a way to choose the font size?

Here is the code chunk

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# Dynamic items
inputPanel(
  
  sliderInput("j", label = "Data Segments:",
              min = 1, max = 40, value = 1, step = 1)
)

output$summary <- renderPrint({
    j=input$j
    ind=seq(b[2*j]-100,b[2*j]+100)
    dataset <- data.frame(id=x[ind,1],x[ind,2],x[ind,6],x[ind,9],x[ind,22],x[ind,10])
    colnames(dataset)=colnames(x)[c(1,2,6,9,22,10)]
    
    summary(dataset)
  })

verbatimTextOutput("summary")

```

Many thanks

Ed
